title: Freeze complete Meta POST authority-path design for B02 before replacement

supersedes.reason: 15G mixed incomplete implementation with design and required two corrective commits (pre-PG gate, location_id propagation). 15G2 freezes the audited design; a bounded replacement slice implements it cleanly from master.

out_of_scope: any runtime behavior change on master paths
deploy / cloud / database / Stripe / production WhatsApp operations
live Meta / WhatsApp / DB / network calls

current_master_posture.shadow: tenant_channel_shadow observe-only; does not override live client_slug
current_master_posture.pg_acquisition: handleMetaWhatsAppWebhookPost always calls withPgClient after normalize on valid JSON

enforcement_order: if blocked → build authority-blocked HTTP envelope; acquired_pg=false; return (zero withPgClient / persistence / draft / send / owner / demo)
else → withPgClient(pg => processMetaWhatsAppWebhookInbound({ pg, env, body, normalized, signatureMeta }))
shared_authority_owner.why_shared: Every post-normalize success branch (guest persist/send, owner Command Center, open demo, no-persistence fallback, duplicate/replay, blocked phone gate) is reached only after the same Staff API POST entry acquires PG today. Authority must gate that single choke point before pool/client acquisition so blocked identities cannot touch any branch.

surfaces: buildMetaInboundIdempotencyKey (location-scoped when location_id present; legacy shape when absent)
owner Command Center send body + stored normalized
open-demo request body (must not hardcode conflicting wolfhouse-somo when authority active)
authoritative_identity_propagation_requi.registry_note: Resolver registry client_slug for Wolfhouse is 'wolfhouse' with location_id 'wolfhouse-somo'; legacy DEFAULT_CLIENT_SLUG remains 'wolfhouse-somo'. Replacement must treat resolver client_slug+location_id as authoritative when policy active, and document alias risk.

replacement_implementation_slice.basis: implement from clean master using 15G2 frozen design; do not cherry-pick deferred 15G branch
bounded_scope: Introduce processMetaWhatsAppWebhookPostEntry; wire handleMetaWhatsAppWebhookPost to it
Apply authority after normalize; block before withPgClient
Propagate trusted location_id through draft/send/idempotency builders
Offline RED/GREEN verifier proving zero PG on block + location propagation on known enabled path
15H overlay; leave 15A historical B02 vulnerable until live activation
explicitly_excluded_from_15h: open-demo booking-write / Stripe / Graph API enablement

must_pass: enabled+routing+known phone_number_id → live client_slug+location_id authoritative through persistence seed, draft input, send body, idempotency key, response.normalized
enabled+routing+unknown|missing|ambiguous|conflicting → authority-blocked response with acquired_pg=false and zero withPgClient/persistence/draft/send/owner/demo calls
default-off → exact current shadow-only master behavior (legacy client_slug, no hard block, PG still acquired as today)
enabled+routing-absent → inactive shadow-only preserved (no hard block)
legacy idempotency key unchanged when location_id absent
no deploy config edits; activation remains default-off
must_not: enable policy on any runtime in-slice
acquire PG before authority decision when policy active+blocked
trust body/options client_slug over resolver when authority active
leave location_id only in tenant_channel_shadow when authority active+known

residual_risk.summary: Until 15H lands and an operator separately activates routing+authority, live B02 remains vulnerable (shadow-only; default wolfhouse-somo live slug). Deferred 15G must not be treated as mergeable remediation.
